name: Wibutime
sumber: Backend Supabase aplikasi Wibutime (katalog, episode, tautan video)

name: AnimeIn
sumber: API AnimeIn (backend aplikasi Nefusoft) + genre dipecah per chip (API mengirim "Drama,Romance") + pesan jelas bila server hanya menyediakan embed mati

name: NontonHentai
sumber: WP REST + GDPlayer HLS jv.abplay.store (NSFW) + populer dari blok Trending beranda + filter Genre (42 slug /genres/)

name: HentaiCop
sumber: WP REST + pemutar /play/v/ (HLS CDN jav.*.site / *.my.id) + filter /series/

name: Anichin
sumber: HTML scraping + ok.ru (HLS/MP4) & Streamruby + arsip /anime (order=popular|update|rating) + filter Status/Tipe/Sub/Genre + pesan jelas bila mirror mati

name: Kuramanime
sumber: HTML Kuramanime; alur 3 langkah (CSRF + token halaman + POST authorization) menghasilkan <source> .my.id/kdrive/*.mp4 (HTTP 206, Range) + filter Urutkan (most_viewed/updated/…) & Genre (/properties/genre/<slug>) + cadangan DNS-over-HTTPS

name: Cosplaytele
sumber: WordPress 7.1.4; katalog /wp-json/wp/v2/posts + populer wordpress-popular-posts; video cossora.stream/embed/<uuid> (AES-CBC kunci 32-hex per video; embed wajib Referer halaman post) + filter Kategori & Tag WordPress (populer difilter lewat taxonomy/term_id)

name: Donghive
sumber: WordPress 7.1.4 (tema animestream); seri = kategori, episode = post; populer dari sidebar #wpop-items (weekly), terbaru via REST _embed=wp:term, genre /genres/<slug>/; video lewat <select class=mirror> base64 -> ok.ru hlsManifestUrl (Dailymotion 403, MEGA tidak bisa diputar)

name: Dongha
sumber: gateway terenkripsi https://gateway.dongha.id (HKDF-SHA256 + ChaCha20-Poly1305); butuh akun (email+sandi di preferensi) untuk login & refresh token; katalog /explore, /latest-episodes, /items/series, episode /items/episodes, video /media/episodes/<id>/sources (MP4 360-1080p, tanpa DRM)

name: LayarAnime
sumber: HTML+Jsoup; kartu <article> a[itemprop=url]/meta[itemprop=image]/h2[itemprop=name]; daftar /ongoing & /release (24 kartu), cari /search?q=; episode /<slug>/episode-N -> iframe player.ablink.sbs -> halaman pemutar memuat m3u8 langsung (segmen .pict/MPEG-TS, tanpa Referer)

name: NontonAnimeID
sumber: WordPress kotakanime; kartu div.sera; /popular-series/, /ongoing-list/, /?s=; seri /anime/<slug>/ (h1 data-title-default); episode data-post + data-nume/type; POST admin-ajax player_ajax -> iframe -> embed; payload di-XOR (kunci dari skrip) -> /go/dl/?url=k.<hash> -> 302 -> mp4 720p/360p

name: KaitoAni
sumber: WordPress; kartu article.bs (a[href] + img.ts-post-image); /hentai-list/ + /page/N/, beranda, /?s=; seri /hentai/<slug>/; episode memuat 3 tautan MediaFire (1080/720/480) -> halaman MediaFire -> tautan download*.mediafire.com (uji Range 206 video/mp4). Pemutar situs memakai packer kaomoji (belum diporting).

name: Samehadaku
sumber: WordPress; kartu article.bs; katalog /anime/?order=popular|update; cari /anime/?s=; genre /genres/<slug>/; episode .eplister; video iframe blogger.com/video.g → googlevideo (itag 22/18).

name: Anoboy
sumber: WordPress; kartu article.bs; katalog /anime/?order=popular|update; cari /anime/?s=; genre /genres/<slug>/; episode .eplister; video vkspeed (JW Player ter-packer → mp4 vkcdn) dengan cadangan googlevideo blogger.
